claimed_scope: Build the smallest deterministic, persistence-agnostic AgencyState contract for explicit interests, open loops, and deferred intents. It may validate, freeze, fingerprint and purely evolve caller-supplied agency-state items under an explicit generation/state-digest fence. It must not infer interests/goals/world facts, read/write UnifiedDB, evaluate wake conditions, choose Persistent Pulse actions, call providers/tools, execute effects, or mint completion. Source plus deterministic tests and public repository CI only; no VPS/physical-GRID10/whole-system credit.
dependencies: F2-WP-200 Persistent Pulse remains separate active authority
F2-WP-201 StateFingerprint remains separate active authority
F2-WP-202 PredictionContract/residual accepted component is an external signal boundary only
F2-WP-100/F2-WP-101 identity/state authority boundaries remain external
